hints.title: Bounded Top Rank Filtering
hints.text: Retain only the k largest values seen so far inside a container whose boundary continuously yields the k-th largest element.

hints.title: Size-Constrained Heap Maintenance
hints.text: Push incoming numbers into the heap. Whenever the heap size exceeds k, pop the smallest element so that the minimum of the top k remains at index zero.

hints.title: KthLargest Blueprint
hints.text: In init: store k, initialize heap. For num in nums: add(num). In add(val): heappush(heap, val). If len(heap) > k: heappop(heap). Return heap[0].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: K: rank of largest element to maintain
complexity.notes: Each add operation executes in O(log K) heap push and pop time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting the accumulated stream takes O(N log N) on every new insertion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bounded size K min-heap avoids retaining non-qualifying elements.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintaining min-heap of capacity K rather than max-heap of full size N.
